_comment: District and municipal emergency contacts for the affected corridor. NOTHING HERE IS AUTO-POPULATED, and nothing here may be guessed. A wrong number on a disaster page sends someone in trouble to a phone that does not answer, so every entry must be copied from an official source — the District Administration Office, the District Emergency Operation Centre, or the Nepal Police district listing — and the source recorded below with the date it was checked. Ship this empty rather than approximate: the page hides any district with no verified numbers, and shows the national helplines instead.

districts._example: Copy this shape for each district once the numbers are verified, then delete this example entry.
